dialogue.text: Thank you. Before we close, we can settle the correspondence preferences you mentioned. For future portfolio updates, would you prefer a short written overview ahead of our conversation, with the supporting documents kept separately?

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that preference for correspondence. The overview can stay separate from the supporting material, with clear headings so you can find what you need. Would you like routine administrative matters kept in the same message, or handled separately?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That is helpful. I will keep the appointment arrangements distinct from the private correspondence. On future calls, is there a practical way to arrange a time while you are travelling, without interrupting your business meetings?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
